summary: Iteration 4 testing complete. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed covering invoice auto-log lifecycle (create, patch, cascade delete, default true, null account fallback, category mapping, filterable in /transactions). Frontend: full lifecycle verified on a new invoice (create -> 2 linked tx, edit amount -> 2 linked with no duplicates, uncheck auto-log -> 0 linked, delete invoice -> 0 linked). InvoiceForm extraction confirmed with all 17 required data-testids present. Auto-logged badge renders on invoice rows. Seeded INV-2026-CV-0001 left intact.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 833 lines; consider splitting routers (auth/accounts/invoices/transactions/dashboard) into separate modules.

_sync_invoice_expense_transactions performs delete_many then insert_many sequentially without a transaction — if the insert step fails mid-flight, the invoice would lose its linked tx silently. Low priority unless atomicity is required.

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests. allow_origin_regex='.*' is the only reason this works; the redundant allow_origins='*' should be removed for clarity.
Invoices.jsx still imports PARTICULAR_PRESETS and emptyParticular from InvoiceForm — good extraction, but itemsToParticulars/particularsToItems helpers could live alongside the form for cohesion.
seed_data_creation: Test invoices INV-IT4-001..008 are created and deleted within each test; no residual seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py runs in ~3s. Reuse the same login + ctx fixtures for new invoice features. Seeded invoice INV-2026-CV-0001 with 6 linked transactions ($9,300 subtotal) is the baseline.
